description: This file defines the ArrayExpression class in Twig, which manages array expressions within the Twig templating language, including construction, key-value management, element addition, and compilation to PHP code.

classes.name: ArrayExpression
classes.description: Represents an array expression node in Twig, capable of managing array elements, checking elements, adding new elements, and compiling array code efficiently.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ArrayExpression with given elements and line number, and determines the highest numeric key.

methods.name: getKeyValuePairs
methods.description: Returns the array's key-value pairs as an array of pairs.

methods.name: hasElement
methods.description: Checks if a specific key element exists within the array.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element to the array with an optional key; if no key is provided, it uses an auto-incremented index.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the array expression into PHP code, handling spread operators and key-value formatting.

methods.name: hasSpreadItem
methods.description: Checks if any element in the key-value pairs has a 'spread' attribute.
